ELSE 'Khác'

CASE WHEN STATUS = 'RECEIVED' THEN 'Đã tiếp nhận'

ELSE 'Khác'

FROM THANHTRA_UAT.PETITION

ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM RECEIVED_DATE) DESC";;;;;Done;Dữ liệu tĩnh
